Professional embedded engineer: production-grade Microchip AT21CS01/AT21CS11 driver for ESP32-S2/S3, Arduino, PlatformIO. Prioritize deterministic behavior, robust errors, maintainable API, predictable field behavior.

Layout: `include/AT21CS/` public headers only; `src/` implementation (.cpp); `common/` example-only helpers. `examples/common/` is not part of the library. Keep minimal examples: one full single-device CLI and one multi-device CLI. No board-specific pin defaults in library code.

No unbounded loops; every wait needs a timeout/deadline. No dynamic allocation in steady-state library operation. No logging in library code; examples may log. No `delay()` in library code except bounded protocol timing/bit windows.

Single-wire timed bit protocol, MSb-first. Discovery handshake required after reset/power-up. Preserve ACK/NACK phase granularity in errors. During t_WR busy cycle, keep SI/O high and use bounded ready polling. AT21CS11 is High-Speed only; Standard Speed requests must fail cleanly.

Use explicit state machine in code and docs: `UNINIT`, `PROBING`, `INIT_CONFIG`, `READY`, `BUSY`, `DEGRADED`, `OFFLINE`, `RECOVERING`, `SLEEPING`, `FAULT`. Transitions must remain explicit in lifecycle and recovery paths.

All fallible APIs return `Status`:
const char* msg;
No silent failures. Validation/precondition errors must not be disguised as transport failures.

`Version.h` - Auto-generated (do not edit). `Version.h` is generated by `scripts/generate_version.py`. Source of truth: `library.json`. Versioning: MAJOR API breaks; MINOR backward-compatible features; PATCH fixes/docs/refactors.

`docs/AT21CS01_AT21CS11_complete_driver_report.md` is a static chip reference. Do not modify its technical content unless explicitly requested by the maintainer.

Naming: members `_camelCase`; methods/functions, locals/params, config fields `camelCase`; constants `CAPS_CASE`.
